name: UniFirst Corporation
summary: UniFirst Corporation provides workplace uniforms and protective work wear clothing in the United States, Europe, and Canada. It operates through Uniform & Facility Service Solutions; First Aid & Safety Solutions; and Other segments. The company offers uniforms, including shirts, pants, jackets, coveralls, lab coats, smocks, and aprons; specialized protective wear comprising flame resistant and high visibility garments; and first aid cabinet services and other safety supplies, as well as safety training services.
